_comment: Curated A17 test-point data. Hand-authored from the service manuals rather than
parsed, because the printed sources need four corrections and disagree in two
places that no parser should resolve on its own:
1. Table 2-10 prints the -15 S row's signal name as '15S', losing the sign. The
legend on schematic sheet 1 gives it as -15S and the nominal is -15 V.
2. Table 2-10 has no +15 S row at all, though §2-71 says the assembly has 13
regulated outputs and §2-74 describes the +15 S regulator (U4). Its value here
comes from fault code 3602.
3. For the two 17 S rails the table's 'Nominal Output' cell is the near limit of
the band, not its centre: it prints +17.000 V +/-475 mV, while the sheet-1
annotation and fault code 3600 both give +17.0 V to +17.95 V -- a band of the
same width centred on +17.475 V. The same holds for -17 S. Two independent
sources agree against the table, so the band is taken from them and the
table's printed cell is recorded in 'conflict'.
4. Fault code 3608 gives +5 RLH as +4.9 V to +5.5 V, which does not overlap the
+5.55 V to +6.40 V that Table 2-10 and the sheet-1 annotation both give. The
two agreeing sources are used; the fault code is recorded in 'conflict' rather
than dropped, because a technician following 3608 needs to know.
Signal names are transcribed from the legend boxes on schematic sheets 1 and 2.
TP59 does not exist -- the sheet-2 legend runs TP58, TP60.
'kind' separates the nine wire loops that are on the parts list (TP1, TP4, TP6,
TP8-TP10, TP12, TP55, TP58 -- 'JUMPER,WIRE,NONINSUL,0.200CTR', stock 816090) from
the plated eyelets, which are board features with no part number. The loops take a
clip lead; the eyelets take a probe tip.
'source' on every value says where it came from; 'inferred' marks values the
manuals do not state outright.

testpoints.note: Return for +30 FR1. Floating with respect to the other commons.
Sheet 1 annotates the output +29.30 V to +32.63 V, which is this band.
Return for +30 FR2. Floating with respect to the other commons.
Sheet 1 annotates the output +29.30 V to +32.63 V, which is this band.
Return for +15 OSC and -15 OSC. Fault code 3614 checks it for 0 V +/-50 mV against RCOM.
Fault code 3612 gives the same band, +14.2 V to +15.8 V. Used only by A12 and A13.
Fault code 3613 gives the same band, -14.2 V to -15.8 V.
Return for +5 LH, +5 RLH, -5 LH and +8 RLH. Tied to S COM (TP9) on this assembly. Fault code 3606 checks it for 0 V +/-50 mV against RCOM.
TO-3 regulator U8, raised above +5 V by R13 with CR34/CR35.

testpoints.conflict: Fault code 3608 states +4.9 V to +5.5 V for this rail, which does not overlap the +5.55 V to +6.40 V given by Table 2-10 and by the sheet-1 annotation. The two agreeing sources are used here.
testpoints.note: Sheet 1 annotates the output +5.55 V to +6.40 V.
Fault code 3607 gives the same band, -4.7 V to -5.3 V.
The assembly's one unregulated output: the +5 LHR input fused by F1 (3.15 A slow-blow). Its value follows the unregulated input, so the band is wide. Out of tolerance means replace F1 first.
Return for +/-44 S, +/-17 S and +/-15 S. Tied to LH COM (TP10) on this assembly, and 44 S COM and 17 S COM are tied together here. Fault code 3615 checks it for 0 V +/-50 mV against RCOM.

testpoints.source: Figure 7-21 sheet 1 annotation, agreeing with S5-2 fault code 3600
testpoints.conflict: Table 2-10 prints the nominal as +17.000 V +/-475 mV, which would place the band at +16.53 V to +17.48 V. The sheet-1 annotation (+17.0 V to +17.95 V) and fault code 3600 (+17.0 V to +18.0 V) both put it half a volt higher, so the table's nominal cell is read as the near limit of the band rather than its centre.

testpoints.source: Figure 7-21 sheet 1 annotation, agreeing with S5-2 fault code 3601
testpoints.conflict: Table 2-10 prints the nominal as -17.000 V +/-835 mV. The sheet-1 annotation (-17.03 V to -18.7 V) and fault code 3601 (-17.0 V to -18.7 V) agree with each other against it; see TP8 for the same discrepancy on the positive rail.

testpoints.note: Table 2-10 has no row for this rail even though §2-71 counts 13 regulated outputs. §2-74 describes it: fixed +15 V TO-220 regulator U4 from the unregulated +17 SR.
Table 2-10 prints the signal name as '15S' with the sign lost; the sheet 1 legend gives -15S and the nominal is negative. Fault code 3603 gives the same band, -14.2 V to -15.8 V.
Sheet 1 annotates +42.12 V to +46.18 V, which is this band. Fault code 3604 uses a slightly tighter +42.0 V to +45.6 V, and checks the unregulated +44 SR on A18 first.
Sheet 1 annotates -42.12 V to -46.18 V, which is this band. Fault code 3605 uses a slightly tighter -42.0 V to -45.6 V.
Guarded digital ground, by the input power filter. TP58 is the same node at the microcontroller.
Guarded digital ground at the microcontroller. Same node as TP55.
Supply for the guarded digital section. Sheet 2 shows it as +5 LH from sheet 1 through the 3-turn choke L51, so the expectation here is +5 LH's; the manuals do not tabulate VCC2 separately.
The 8 MHz sine wave this assembly generates for the analog assemblies, from crystal Y52 and inverter U51. A frequency, not a level -- the manuals give no amplitude.

testpoints.source: inferred from Y51 (4.9152 MHz) and the 6301 divide-by-four
testpoints.note: Enable clock of microcontroller U56. The 6301 core divides its 4.9152 MHz crystal by four, so a dead ECLK with a live TP62 points at Y51 or U56 rather than at the 8 MHz circuit.
Interrupt line on the guarded digital bus, at the P802 connector end. Logic level; the manuals publish no expected value.
Microcontroller port clock. Logic level; the manuals publish no expected value.
Serial clock. Logic level; the manuals publish no expected value.
Receive side of the fibre-optic serial link to the unguarded CPU (A20). Logic level; the manuals publish no expected value.
Transmit side of the fibre-optic serial link to the unguarded CPU (A20), driven by U57. Logic level; the manuals publish no expected value.
Active-low reset from supervisor U60 and the watchdog. Should sit high once the instrument is running; a low here holds the inguard CPU in reset. Logic level; the manuals publish no expected value.
Power-on-panic input from the watchdog counter U59. Logic level; the manuals publish no expected value.
Microcontroller port line P61. Logic level; the manuals publish no expected value.
Microcontroller port line P60. Logic level; the manuals publish no expected value.
